conclusions: RF10 gross physical collapse is absent in this RF11 run; validation failure count is 0/30 versus RF09 2/30 and RF10 29/30.
RF09-to-RF11 validation root XY common-prefix error increases while upper-limb average is almost unchanged; this is not full-body tracking success.
Two fixed forward-walk examples now finish but remain close to the ground most of the time; geometric support is not a contact-force or slip measurement.
Fixed two-handed gesture has substantially insufficient wrist height and unmatched peak timing.
RF11 retains the same sampler repair already present in RF10 while retracting combined observation/reward changes. The unique cause of RF10 collapse is not isolated.
limits: One seed and unequal learning/update counts; no statistical improvement claim.
Native RF11 contact forces, foot slip and complete actor-objective H32 gradient quality were not remeasured.
MP4s are eight independently initialized segments at original speed, not continuous 54-second control.
Weights and full trajectories are server LOCAL_ONLY; no cloud backup claim.
